_what_this_is: Annotation provenance for KY_trimmed.json. Not a golden and never graded: these are the working keys the annotation was built with, kept because they record HOW the golden was produced, which the golden itself no longer shows.
⚠️_derivation_and_its_limit: Every row was seeded from the pipeline's own output and then checked against kentucky_all_standards_2021_trimmed.pdf by the annotator. That supports a PRECISION claim — every emitted element was inspected — and it does NOT support a RECALL claim, because verifying emitted rows cannot find omissions. An element the detector never emitted is absent here too, invisibly. Independent structural evidence bounds that gap at the middle levels: all 17 printed 'Benchmark N.N:' ids and all 15 '<Domain> Standard N:' headings in the document appear in the detector golden. The 202 indicators carry no equivalent check.
page_numbering: ⚠️ THREE PAGE NUMBERINGS APPEAR BELOW AND THEY ARE NOT THE SAME NUMBER. `source_page` is the page in the _trimmed PDF the pipeline actually processed (1-52). `_published_pdf_page` is that page's index in the 120-page published PDF. `_printed_page_number` is what is PRINTED at the bottom of the page, which is what you see when annotating from the document — it runs 13 behind the PDF index because the front matter is unnumbered. Trimmed p2 = PDF p52 = printed p39. An earlier version of this file carried only `_published_page`, which read as the printed number and was the PDF index; that field is renamed and the printed number added.
